definitions.explanation: Flexible connective tissue found in joints, ears, nose, and other parts of the body. Provides cushioning and structure.
Chicken cartilage served as a food item, popular in Japanese cuisine, especially at yakitori restaurants.

examples.japanese: {膝|ひざ}の{軟骨|なんこつ}がすり{減|へ}ってきた。
examples.english: The cartilage in my knee is wearing down.

examples.japanese: {耳|みみ}の{軟骨|なんこつ}にピアスを{開|あ}けた。
examples.english: I got my ear cartilage pierced.

examples.japanese: {年|とし}を{取|と}ると{軟骨|なんこつ}がすり{減|へ}って{関節|かんせつ}が{痛|いた}くなることがある。
examples.english: As you age, cartilage wears down and your joints can become painful.

examples.japanese: {軟骨|なんこつ}のから{揚|あ}げが{好|す}きだ。
{焼|や}き{鳥屋|とりや}で{軟骨|なんこつ}を{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
examples.english: I ordered cartilage at the yakitori restaurant.

examples.japanese: {軟骨|なんこつ}はコリコリした{食感|しょっかん}が{特徴|とくちょう}で、{塩|しお}で{食|た}べるのが{一番|いちばん}おいしい。
examples.english: Cartilage is known for its crunchy texture, and it tastes best with salt.

notes:
TYPES:
- {硝子軟骨|しょうしなんこつ}: hyaline cartilage (joints, ribs)
- {弾性軟骨|だんせいなんこつ}: elastic cartilage (ear, nose)
- {線維軟骨|せんいなんこつ}: fibrocartilage (spine discs)

MEDICAL TERMS:
- {軟骨損傷|なんこつそんしょう}: cartilage damage
- {変形性関節症|へんけいせいかんせつしょう}: osteoarthritis (involves cartilage)

AS FOOD:
At {焼|や}き{鳥|とり} (yakitori) restaurants:
- {軟骨|なんこつ} / なんこつ: chicken cartilage (crunchy texture)
- {やげん軟骨|やげんなんこつ}: breast cartilage
- {ひざ軟骨|ひざなんこつ}: knee cartilage

Popular for its unique crunchy texture.
